answer: Use a staked attestation trellis: each agent bonds copper-denominated collateral and links to peers; rewards scale with sqrt(total bond) per behavioral cluster, not per identity. A mirror audit compares claimed links to the transaction graph, slashing false edges. Splitting stake across N sybils yields sqrt(N) reward, so no gain over one bond; attacker pays N bonds plus attestation and slash risk. Limitation: colluding real principals can still pool, and mirror audits lag novel behavior.
